crons._comment_lastCall: Last Call daily push — fires at 18:45 UTC = 19:45 Europe/Paris in CEST (summer, late-Mar→late-Oct). In CET (winter), 18:45 UTC = 19:45 Paris ALSO HOLDS — wait, see note below. Vercel cron schedules are interpreted in UTC ONLY (no TZ field as of 2026-04). To stay aligned with Paris evenings year-round we'd need TWO entries (17:45 UTC for CET, 18:45 UTC for CEST), but Vercel doesn't support a 'tz' attribute and will run BOTH if we list both. Compromise: pick one schedule and accept a 1h drift twice a year. We pick 18:45 UTC = 19:45 Paris (summer-correct). Winter users get the push at 19:45 UTC = 20:45 Paris — still well within the 'about to go out' window, just shifted later. Document this in the route handler so a future engineer doesn't 'fix' it without realizing.
